caption: The worked example's task counts sit inside each framework activity: 6 + 5 + 8 + 12 + 4 = 35 framework tasks, plus the 3 umbrella tasks, gives 38. Construction's 12 tasks are 12 ÷ 38 = 31.6% of that total; the umbrella tasks cover every activity and are not a sixth step.

spec.title: Task set for one release (worked example)
spec.aria: A downward chain of five blocks — Communication 6 tasks, Planning 5, Modeling 8, Construction 12, Deployment 4 — with an arrow from Deployment back to Communication marked next increment, a separate umbrella block of 3 tasks joined by dashed lines to Communication and Deployment, and Construction marked as 31.6% of the 38-task total.
